purpose: Describe your own action humbly and politely.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
いたす / いたします replaces する.
formation: いたす / いたします replaces する.
restrictions: Typically lowers the speaker’s or in-group action in a respectful interaction.
mistake: Do not use it as a respectful verb for the customer’s action.
